description.value: Nomad is an eco-conscious espresso bar, café, and bakery that operates as a proudly 100% single-use cup-free shop—customers bring their own tumbler, use an on-site ceramic mug, or rent a sustainably 3D-printed clay cup made from clay, salt, and water. Founded by Annette Kim, whose earlier North Vancouver café reduced landfill waste by 95%, Nomad has collectively diverted over 250,000 single-use cups from landfills since 2022. The Kitsilano location opened in early 2026, bringing this zero-waste coffee culture to a neighbourhood popular with cyclists riding the waterfront and nearby routes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record at 2143 Yew Street maps to Nomad's Kitsilano branch, confirmed by a 2026-04-23 blog post titled 'A Heritage Worth Keeping: Nomad Coffee Kitsilano at 2143 Yew Street' and the Location page, which lists a 'Kitsilano' entry with phone 604-336-1021 and email kits@nomadyvr.ca. OSM carries no phone number, so the Kitsilano-specific number from the website is used; the footer number (604-770-1930) belongs to the Bewicke/North Vancouver flagship. No explicit evidence for bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or most cyclist amenities appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM has no phone number; the Kitsilano-specific number (604-336-1021) was sourced from the website Location page. The footer number (604-770-1930) belongs to the Bewicke/North Vancouver flagship and should not be used for this listing.
This is Nomad's second location, opened early 2026. A separate OSM node likely exists or may be created for the Bewicke flagship—verify no duplicate listing in the directory.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-established café in a cycling-friendly Kitsilano neighbourhood with a distinctive sustainability identity; a worthwhile stop for touring cyclists. Bike-specific amenities should be verified on-site.
